title: Challah Pizza
subtitle: a quick bake with leftover bread
description: Slices of challah topped with pizza sauce, cheese and your favourite toppings, ready in 20 minutes.

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180°C and line a baking tray with baking paper.
Slice the challah and arrange the slices on the tray, packed tightly together.
Spread pizza sauce over each slice. Sprinkle generously with grated cheese and add your favourite toppings.
Bake for 20 minutes, or until golden.
